api_connect_codes_approval_check.name: api_connect_codes_approval_check
api_connect_codes_approval_check.value: ("api_connect_codes"."approved_at" is null) = ("api_connect_codes"."owner_user_id" is null) and ("api_connect_codes"."approved_at" is null) = ("api_connect_codes"."key_scopes" is null) and ("api_connect_codes"."approved_at" is null) = ("api_connect_codes"."key_expires_at" is null) and ("api_connect_codes"."approved_at" is null) = ("api_connect_codes"."key_name" is null)

service_principals_creator_client_check.name: service_principals_creator_client_check
service_principals_creator_client_check.value: ("service_principals"."created_by_user_id" is null and "service_principals"."created_by_client_instance_id" is null) or ("service_principals"."created_by_user_id" is not null and "service_principals"."created_by_client_instance_id" is not null and "service_principals"."created_by_client_instance_id" = "service_principals"."client_instance_id")

conversations_run_thread_check.name: conversations_run_thread_check
conversations_run_thread_check.value: ("conversations"."kind" = 'chat' and "conversations"."parent_conversation_id" is null and "conversations"."workflow_run_id" is null and "conversations"."collaboration_workspace_id" is not null and "conversations"."created_by_user_id" is not null and "conversations"."created_by_external_user_id" is not null) or ("conversations"."kind" = 'run_thread' and (("conversations"."parent_conversation_id" is not null and "conversations"."workflow_run_id" is null and "conversations"."collaboration_workspace_id" is not null and "conversations"."created_by_user_id" is not null and "conversations"."created_by_external_user_id" is not null) or ("conversations"."parent_conversation_id" is null and "conversations"."workflow_run_id" is not null and "conversations"."collaboration_workspace_id" is null and "conversations"."created_by_user_id" is null and "conversations"."created_by_external_user_id" is null)))

agent_runs_lineage_check.name: agent_runs_lineage_check
agent_runs_lineage_check.value: ("agent_runs"."parent_run_id" is null and "agent_runs"."root_run_id" is null and "agent_runs"."parent_operation_run_id" is null and "agent_runs"."depth" = 0) or ("agent_runs"."parent_run_id" is not null and "agent_runs"."root_run_id" is not null and "agent_runs"."parent_operation_run_id" is not null and "agent_runs"."depth" = 1)

asset_repo_bundles_live_check.name: asset_repo_bundles_live_check
asset_repo_bundles_live_check.value: ("asset_repo_bundles"."state" = 'live') = ("asset_repo_bundles"."sequence" is not null) and ("asset_repo_bundles"."state" <> 'live' or "asset_repo_bundles"."object_key" is not null)

connection_bindings_scheme_check.name: connection_bindings_scheme_check
connection_bindings_scheme_check.value:
("connection_bindings"."scheme" = 'oauth' and "connection_bindings"."secret_handle" is not null and "connection_bindings"."secret_version" is not null and "connection_bindings"."context_header" is null and "connection_bindings"."context_value" is null)
        or ("connection_bindings"."scheme" = 'person_context' and "connection_bindings"."secret_handle" is null and "connection_bindings"."secret_version" is null and "connection_bindings"."context_header" is not null and ("connection_bindings"."context_value" is not null or "connection_bindings"."state" = 'revoked') and "connection_bindings"."subject" ~ '^person_context:(user|service_principal):.+$')

workflow_runs_active_run_key_idx.name: workflow_runs_active_run_key_idx
workflow_runs_active_run_key_idx.where: "workflow_runs"."run_key" is not null and "workflow_runs"."status" not in ('failed', 'cancelled', 'limit_reached', 'continued')

workflow_runs_retention_idx.name: workflow_runs_retention_idx
workflow_runs_retention_idx.where: "workflow_runs"."data_prune_version" < 1 and "workflow_runs"."data_pruned_at" is null and "workflow_runs"."finished_at" is not null

workflow_runs_retention_repair_idx.name: workflow_runs_retention_repair_idx
workflow_runs_retention_repair_idx.where: "workflow_runs"."data_prune_version" < 1 and "workflow_runs"."data_pruned_at" is not null and "workflow_runs"."finished_at" is not null

workflow_runs_data_prune_idx.name: workflow_runs_data_prune_idx
workflow_runs_data_prune_idx.where: "workflow_runs"."data_pruned_at" is null and "workflow_runs"."finished_at" is not null

workflow_runs_lineage_check.name: workflow_runs_lineage_check
workflow_runs_lineage_check.value: ("workflow_runs"."parent_run_id" is null and "workflow_runs"."parent_step_run_id" is null and "workflow_runs"."depth" = 0) or ("workflow_runs"."parent_run_id" is not null and "workflow_runs"."parent_step_run_id" is not null and "workflow_runs"."root_run_id" is not null and "workflow_runs"."depth" > 0)

workflow_step_runs_iteration_check.name: workflow_step_runs_iteration_check
workflow_step_runs_iteration_check.value: "workflow_step_runs"."iteration" is null or "workflow_step_runs"."container_step_run_id" is not null
